verdict.rationale: Hatchet ships official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby, with the Python SDK verifiably installable from PyPI, plus an official CLI and docs confirming multi-language support (community-confirmed for Python/TS/Go). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of TypeScript/Go/Ruby SDKs (only Python was runtime-probed), and no OpenAPI/spec artifact was found to corroborate SDK completeness.
